description: Animated transparent desktop pet for DeepSeek Harness, with standalone mode and custom pet packs
notes: This is the standalone build and does not require DeepSeek Harness.
Settings are stored in $env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\dsh-pet by default; set DSH_HOME to use another location.
Balance, DSH session status, and system notifications require the DSH host.
The Electron runtime is downloaded to $env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\electron on first launch.
